name: Walking in purity
promise: Five days of teaching to help you resist lust, choose purity and grow in fellowship with God.
why: For believers who want freedom from lust and a life that honours Jesus. Begin with the grace Christ provides, then settle your commitment before temptation comes. Learn when to leave a compromising situation, guard the life of your mind and grow in daily fellowship with the indwelling Holy Spirit. The days move from confidence in Christ to practical choices and a sustained relationship with Him.

days.key_quote: There is something stronger than sin. It is called grace.

days.theme: Choose purity before the pressure comes
days.key_quote: I have a living relationship with Jesus that I cannot trade for anything.
I had to escape in order for me to be saved. I did a lot of escaping. May you have the strength to escape in the name of Jesus Christ.

days.theme: Tend the life of your mind
days.key_quote: The contamination of this world will corrupt you if you are not diligent to tend the fire.

days.theme: Grow in the life God has given you
days.key_quote: The same grace that makes you dead to sin is the same grace that makes you alive to God.
